messages.subject: measurementInvarianceCat
parts:
I'm trying to check for measurement invariance for latent variables with categorical indicators (syntax below). My problem is that even though I try to specify the estimator accordingly, it gives me this error: Error in lav_options_set(opt) : 
  lavaan ERROR: estimator ML for ordered data is not supported yet. Use WLSMV instead.

malli <- '
+ external =~  border + anti + na + gprob + rooki + adhd + alc
+ internal =~ commonmd +suic + suica +  ptsd + eat  '
> measurementInvarianceCat(malli, data = data2, group = "sp", parameterization="theta", 
+                          estimator="WLSMV", ordered = c("eat","commonmd", "suic", "adhd",
+                                                         "suica", "ptsd", "rooki", "na",
+                                                         "gprob ","alc", "anti", "border"))


Thanks for any help!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: measurementInvarianceCat
parts: Is it most likely that the problem is due to the older version?

Yes.  Since you are unable to install a newer R, I temporarily changed the requirement to all R >= 3.3.  lavaan still only requires R > 3.1, so I imagine it will be safe, but I cannot guarantee it will stay that way for long (it has been a couple years since either package has been updated on CRAN, but that should happen soon).

You can install the semTools package again, and it should work now.
